meta.what: Standard spellings and their recorded variants, under the ruling recorded as proposal 5 in docs/decisions-log.md.
rule: Each word has one standard spelling: the one the developer notes or the guide give, or failing that the most frequent in game text.
The course teaches only the standard, and the forge checker accepts only the standard in new writing.
Game texts are never altered. They are shown as written, and a rare spelling is marked as a variant of its standard word.
A variant is not a separate word.
meta.counts: Occurrences are whole-word counts over the game texts in canon-corpus.json with duplicate records left out.

apostrophe.ruling: Proposal 9, the owner's ruling of 2026-11-18. The apostrophe between two u's writes a break in the voice, a glottal stop. Where that sound is made the standard spelling has the apostrophe, whether or not the game or an inscription writes it. Writing the word without it is accepted, but it is not the standard. Two u's with no break between them are one long u and are written uu.

long_u_without_apostrophe.basis: the Fifth Edition says it should not be spoken as three syllables or with a glottal stop
the reading convention gives one long u

long_u_without_apostrophe.meaning: a personal name on a word wall

in_runes: A break is written with two separate U runes. The single double-U rune stands for one long u.
The runes have no sign for the apostrophe. A break mark is to be designed with the other new signs; once it exists the standard rune spelling carries it between the two U runes.
Game inscriptions are shown as written. The Throw Voice word wall writes thu'um with the double-U rune, and a High Hrothgar banner writes tu'um the same way; both are recorded variants.
apostrophe.possessive_endings: By the owner's ruling of 2026-11-20 the same stop separates the two i's of the possessive endings, which are written -i'i (his, her, its) and -i'il (your). This applies to the endings only; inside a word the doubled i is one long vowel. See grammar-rulings.json, G07-possessive-endings.
apostrophe.in_new_words: The forge accepts an apostrophe in two places only: between two u's where the coiner declares a break, and in the possessive endings -i'i and -i'il. Elsewhere it is rejected.
apostrophe.not_decided: Whether a break may be written between other vowels inside a word (a'a, or i'i other than in the endings). The games have no such word.

unexplained_forms.note: A plural of hin ("your") in one line of dialogue. The regular plural would be hinne, which does not occur. Left unexplained and not taught.
